source: his 2026-10-23: the military family ("like 10 missionboard missions for Military Dungeons"), "we have droppods, those would be cool", 13:35 "don't limit ourselves by what's there already in my mod, we can add the markers needed later", 13:44 "go for it"
_note: THE MILITARY FAMILY, 4 OF ~10: THE UPLINK.
Start the site's uplink from its own terminal, then hold the room while it sends. The verb is HOLD: the first of the
family where you stay put. Waves defend the terminal (a hold's defend). Rung 1 squads, rung 3 a horde.
Written to the delve marker set (outside entrance, centre, item markers, boss, wounded) on his ruling, so the
lint pool is EMPTY on military sites until the markers are on them (missionboard06a's note says why).
Every word holds at any military site: nothing names the site, the faction or the weather; everything the lines
point at is placed. Pay: med, capped.

place._theme: Military sites; the family's marker set.

prose.name: Uplink: Site Records on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The <Place> holds records somebody wants sent home before the occupiers wipe them. The terminal can send them. It just takes a while.
prose.card: Data contract. The site terminal at the <Place> on <Planet> holds records we need transmitted. Start the uplink and keep it running until it completes. Expect resistance. Payment on contract completion.

beats.journal: The uplink is running. The progress bar is the slowest thing I have ever watched, and something in the <Place> has noticed.
beats.name: Site Uplink Terminal
say: It's sending? Good. It's loud on every channel, so they'll know. Keep them off it till it finishes.

beats.journal: I held the room until the uplink finished. Every record the <Place> had is on its way home.
say: That's the last packet. Everything's through. Whatever they do to the place now, it's too late.

broadcast: You're at the site? The terminal inside can send everything we need. It's slow, and it's loud. Once you start it, you'll have to stay with it.
_speech: On a board the broadcast waits for him at the site. Not yet heard in game; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency in a voiced line.
